title: AE Audits
subtitle: Agent-native code review
summary: Decision review for expensive bets. A structured adversarial council — 15 specialized lenses — before you commit capital, time, or reputation.
body:
AE Audits is agent-native review for high-stakes decisions. Instead of a single model opinion, you get a structured adversarial council across 15 specialized lenses: architecture, security, economics, ops, product, and more.

Pricing tiers stay simple: async brief from $490, full council $1,890, strategic from $4,200. Output is a decision-grade brief you can act on — not a dashboard demo.

title: CLDCDE
subtitle: Developer ecosystem
summary: Claude Code ecosystem hub — tools, patterns, and operator infrastructure for agentic development.
body: CLDCDE is the public surface for Claude Code ecosystem work: tooling, patterns, and operator infrastructure that make agentic development shippable. Live at cldcde.cc.

title: clawREFORM
subtitle: Agent city
summary: Agent-city surface for coordination, reform patterns, and multi-agent operations.
body: clawREFORM explores multi-agent coordination as an urban metaphor — agents as operators in a shared city. Production surface at clawreform.com.

title: veritas-operator
subtitle: Research pipeline
summary: Research pipeline operator for evidence gathering, synthesis, and verification loops.
body: veritas-operator is a research pipeline built for agents that need evidence, not vibes. It coordinates retrieval, synthesis, and verification as a production workflow under the aegntic org.

title: obsidian-indexer
subtitle: Sovereign operator
summary: Local-first knowledge indexing for sovereign operator workflows — vaults, memory, and agent retrieval.
body: obsidian-indexer turns local vaults into agent-readable memory. Built for sovereign operators who keep context on-device and still want agents that can search, classify, and act.

title: Prologue
subtitle: Memory library
summary: Universal MCP discovery and memory library — cut setup from hours to minutes.
body: Prologue is MCP discovery and memory infrastructure for agent stacks. The goal is simple: stop re-solving auth, discovery, and wiring every time a new agent surface comes online. Live at logue.pro.

body: zkputer captures R&D around zero-knowledge compute and privacy-preserving agent execution. Wireframe and research notes live in the projects archive.
